traditional: 將 A 講到冇咁重要
jyutping: zoeng1 A gong2 dou3 mou5 gam3 zung6 jiu3

english.note: Use this spoken pattern when deliberately downplaying A or making it sound less important than it is.

examples.english: They always diminish the importance of their own achievements.
examples.traditional: 佢成日將自己嘅功勞講到冇咁重要。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gung1 lou4 gong2 dou3 mou5 gam3 zung6 jiu3
